description: This file implements the CollateralReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve collateral data related to loans from the database, including fetching all collaterals for a loan and a specific collateral by ID. It uses JDBC for data access and maps SQL query results to CollateralData objects.

classes.name: CollateralReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CollateralReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to fetch collateral data for loans.

classes.name: CollateralMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to CollateralData objects.

methods.name: retrieveCollaterals
methods.description: Fetches all collateral records associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveCollateral
methods.description: Fetches a specific collateral attached to a loan by collateral ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveCollateralsForValidLoan
methods.description: Validates the loan exists and then fetches its collaterals.

calls: this.jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(sql, rm, new Object[] { loanId, collateralId })
